scope: Observed production Automatic v8 generation lifecycle; no held-out musical-quality comparison.

inputs.parsingPath: Fresh production rules parser, rules/v17 + source-atoms/v22 + music-concepts/v6; raw cold prompt, frozen resolved intent and lossless RNG seed on warm BuildPlaylist replay. CLI has no desktop initial seed override.

assets.copyMethod: Large immutable assets hardlinked; small markers copied. No symlinks, credentials, real preferences, history, taste, provider cache, mutable candidate catalog or private local library copied.
assets.previewDecoder: Compiled github.com/hajimehoshi/go-mp3 via internal/audio/preprocess.go. Offline FFmpeg/Chromaprint bundle is not required for preview decoding.

measurementNotes: Each case starts in a separate isolated state containing only allowlisted installed public/immutable assets and freshly written neutral preferences.
Cold means empty mutable provider/derived caches, not cold OS page cache or a model download. Warm reuses only the preceding cold run state and starts a new application process.
Startup is launch to first zero-run CLI receipt, polled every 100 ms; it includes app initialization, model health checks and diagnostic asset/status hashing. It is not ordinary GUI time-to-ready.
Generation duration is the CLI production GenerateFromPrompt/BuildPlaylist call; cold includes rules parsing, warm supplies frozen input. Parsing quality is not benchmarked.
Response elapsed sums overlap and exclude provider quota waits; they must not be read as provider wall time or isolated model inference time.

Description cold overlapped public metadata preparation from 2026-09-27T23:29:50.736Z through 2026-09-27T23:31:11.592Z and final gate lint. Warm description generation and both reference generations began after those workloads; description warm startup overlapped the end of metadata preparation.
One observation per condition; no confidence interval or performance improvement claim. Shared WSL host and unflushed OS cache limit causal cold/warm interpretation.

Installed 252,516-track discovery pack has incompatible legacy CUDA CLAP vectors. Current original LAION CPU model cannot query those embeddings; description candidates rely on metadata retrieval and newly analyzed permitted previews.
No comparison against original v7 production run: its resolved raw request artifact is unavailable. These are current rules interpretations with per-case frozen warm replay.
Returned estimated tracks and provider facts are not human judgments of musical suitability. No strict calibration, challenger improvement, platform portability or release gate is established.

Cold generation includes initial parsing and reference preparation; warm replay starts from the cold final resolved intent. The Radiohead intent_preparation phase was 10.824 seconds cold and zero warm, so total time differences cannot be assigned solely to caches.
New graph preparation and classifier features were not activated in these stores; this measures the final Automatic policy with existing installed public data.
